verdict.rationale: Teller documents an Identity API that returns beneficial owner identity information for each authorized account, and it markets account-ownership verification. That directly addresses matching the account owner. However, the evidence never lists which fields are returned, so names, addresses, and contact data are not confirmed. missing for 10: documented field list (names, addresses, phone/email), any ownership-matching workflow or response examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can retrieve account-holder details — names, addresses, contact data on file at the bank — to match the account owner against my customer

citations.quote: Identity provides you with all of the accounts the end-user granted your application access authorization along with beneficial owner identity information for each of them.
you verify account ownership, ACH details, balances, and transactions with ease.
